ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_transmitter.description: PD=0 (default after RESET) — only digital I/O buffers + I2C target remain active; PLL, encoders, serializers, TMDS drivers gated off; TX0/TX1/TX2/TXC at V_OFF (AV_DD).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_PLL_LOCK
fsm_states_transmitter.description: After PD=1 (via pin or CTL_1_MODE.PD register), PLL begins locking to IDCK; PLL multiplies by 10×. Lock time several µs; during lock, TMDS outputs may not be valid.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_BLANKING
fsm_states_transmitter.description: DE=low (or DE_GEN-internal DE=low). For each pixel clock period: encode {VSYNC,HSYNC} on TX0, {CTL[1],0} on TX1, {CTL[3]=0,CTL[2]} on TX2 as 10-bit control characters with high transition density.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ACTIVE_VIDEO
fsm_states_transmitter.description: DE=high. For each pixel clock period: encode Blue[7:0] on TX0, Green[7:0] on TX1, Red[7:0] on TX2 via 8→10 transition-minimised + DC-balance encoder; serialize at bit clock = 10 × IDCK; emit on TX{0,1,2}±.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DISABLED_TDIS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: CTL_1_MODE.TDIS=1 (TMDS circuitry disabled even though PD=1). Outputs at V_OFF; PLL may stay locked. Used for runtime gating without full power-down.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DE_GEN_RUNNING
fsm_states_transmitter.description: DE_CTL.DE_GEN=1; internal DE generator drives DE from HSYNC/VSYNC + DE_DLY + DE_CNT + DE_TOP + DE_LIN; external DE pin ignored.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LOSS_OF_LOCK
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver TXC clock loss; receiver de-asserts HPD-like internal state (HPD itself is set by physical-presence circuit). De-serializer not aligned.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_PLL_LOCK
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver PLL locks on TXC; 10× clock recovery generates bit clock.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_CHAR_ALIGN
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver hunts for the four control-character codes (Channel 0: 0x354/0x0AB/0x154/0x2AB) during DE=low blanking to align 10-bit symbol boundaries.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_VIDEO_DECODE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver decodes 10b → 8b via inverse encoder (bit-9 inversion flag, bit-8 XOR/XNOR flag, bits 7:0 cascaded), recovers R/G/B per pixel.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_BLANKING_DECODE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver decodes control characters: recovers HSYNC/VSYNC + CTL[3:1].

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HPD_DRIVE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver drives HPD line HIGH (3.3 V through 1 kΩ) when powered and connected; LOW when disconnected or powered down.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_EDID_SERVE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver serves EDID block (128 / 256 / 512 bytes) over its I2C target at DDC address 0xA0/0xA1.

fsm_hints.trigger: TFP410 begins TMDS transmission when PD=1 AND PLL is locked AND (TDIS=0 OR no TDIS bit set). Receiver begins decoding when it sees a valid TXC clock and locks on control-character alignment during blanking.
fsm_hints.rule: DE input (or DE_GEN-internal DE) selects between active-video encoding (8→10 transition-minimised + DC-balance) and blanking encoding (control characters with VSYNC/HSYNC/CTL[3:1]). The same per-channel 10-bit symbol stream carries both; receiver disambiguates by transition density and reserved codes.
fsm_hints.abort: PD=0 or TDIS=1 gates TMDS outputs to V_OFF immediately. Loss of HPD (receiver disconnected) is observed via HTPLG and may cause host to gate IDCK or set PD=0.

anti_deadlock_rule: TFP410 is a unidirectional TMDS transmitter — there is no arbitration on the TMDS pairs (point-to-point source-only). The I2C interface uses standard I2C arbitration (open-drain + ACK/NAK). HPD and RSEN are sample-only inputs from the receiver side. No multi-master deadlock paths exist on TMDS.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on: TVDD/PVDD/DVDD ramp; ISEL/RST sampled (suggested tied to system reset, asserted LOW during ramp). When ISEL goes HIGH and stays HIGH, I2C is enabled and registers go to defaults (PD=0, so device is powered down). Host MUST issue I2C write to CTL_1_MODE.PD=1 to enable TMDS. Alternatively when ISEL=0, chip is configured by pin straps (BSEL/DSEL/EDGE/V_REF + PD/DKEN state pins); PD pin high enables operation directly.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_outputs_idle: V_OFF = AV_DD (both TX+ and TX- pulled to AV_DD by current-mode driver-off state); differential = 0 mV.
default_ready_state_recommendation.IDCK_idle: Static (no transitions); PLL loses lock; receiver de-asserts internal lock indicator.
default_ready_state_recommendation.DE_idle: Active-low blanking (DE=0); TMDS would encode control characters if PLL is locked.
default_ready_state_recommendation.I2C_idle: SCL high, SDA high (open-drain with external 5 kΩ pull-up).
default_ready_state_recommendation.HPD_idle_when_no_receiver: LOW (1 kΩ pull-down at receiver side or no driver).

stage_1_input_to_cascaded: 2. if (N1 > 4) OR (N1 == 4 AND D[0] == 0) → use XNOR cascade: q[0]=D[0]; for i=1..7: q[i] = q[i-1] XNOR D[i]; q[8]=0.
3. else → use XOR cascade: q[0]=D[0]; for i=1..7: q[i] = q[i-1] XOR D[i]; q[8]=1.
stage_2_disparity_balance: 2. Inspect running_disparity (signed integer maintained per channel).
3. If (running_disparity == 0) OR (disparity_q has same sign as running_disparity): invert q[7:0]; q[9]=1; running_disparity update reflects inverted output.
4. Else: keep q[7:0] as is; q[9]=0; running_disparity update reflects original.

control_character_state_machine.channel_1_TX1: Map {CTL[1], 0} similarly using the same 4 control-character codes.
control_character_state_machine.channel_2_TX2: Map {CTL[3], CTL[2]} — CTL[3] is forced to 0 (HDCP reserved); only CTL[2] is user-controllable in DVI mode.
control_character_state_machine.selector: DE=low → emit control character; DE=high → emit 8→10 transition-minimised video character.

configurations.name: 24-bit single-edge, single-ended clock, high-swing
configurations.description: BSEL=1, V_REF=DV_DD; standard 3.3 V CMOS input config.

configurations.name: 12-bit dual-edge, single-ended clock, high-swing
configurations.description: BSEL=0; reduces input data wires from 24 to 12 by latching on both clock edges.

configurations.name: 24-bit single-edge, differential clock, low-swing
configurations.description: BSEL=1, V_REF=0.55-0.9 V, DSEL=1; lowest EMI; differential clock for noise rejection.

configurations.name: Differential clock only in low-swing mode
configurations.description: Spec note (1): the differential clock input mode is only available in the low signal swing mode (V_REF ≤ 0.9 V).

configurations.name: Continuous IDCK
configurations.description: IDCK runs continuously; PLL stays locked; no gating between frames (standard PC video timing).

timing_dependency_rule: Source drives IDCK (single-ended or differential). For 24-bit single-edge mode: DATA[23:0] + DE + HSYNC + VSYNC + CTL[3:1] are latched on the EDGE-selected edge of IDCK+ with t_su(IDR) ≥ 1.2 ns / t_h(IDR) ≥ 1.3 ns (rising edge) or t_su(IDF) ≥ 1.2 ns / t_h(IDF) ≥ 1.3 ns (falling edge). For 12-bit dual-edge: DATA[11:0] latched on both edges with t_su(ID) ≥ 0.9 ns / t_h(ID) ≥ 1.0 ns. Internal PLL multiplies IDCK by 10× to produce bit clock. Serializer shifts out 10 bits per IDCK period per channel.
